mode.title: Mode
enumTitles: Alerts from the latest weekly reports
Screen my product catalogue against alerts
mode.description: alerts: alert records from the latest weekly reports (filterable). match: check your products (GTIN/EAN, marketplace listing id, brand + model) against recent alerts; one record per product checked.

weeks.title: Weekly reports to scan
weeks.description: Number of latest weekly reports. Default 1 in alerts mode, 8 in match mode.

notifyingCountry.title: Notifying country
notifyingCountry.description: alerts mode: e.g. Finland, Germany (text match).

category.title: Category
category.description: alerts mode: e.g. Toys, Cosmetics, Electrical appliances.

riskType.title: Risk type
riskType.description: alerts mode: e.g. Chemical, Choking, Electric shock.

query.title: Text search
query.description: alerts mode: free text over product, brand, name, model, description.

fromDate.title: Report date from (YYYY-MM-DD)
fromDate.description: alerts mode: only reports on/after this date.

onlyNew.title: Only alerts not seen in previous runs (monitor)
onlyNew.description: alerts mode: for a weekly schedule. Remembers case numbers in the named key-value store 'eu-safety-gate-alerts-state' and outputs (and charges) only new alerts.

products.title: Products to screen (match mode)
products.description: match mode: array of {gtin?, brand?, model?, name?, listingId?}. Max 10,000 per run.

maxResults.title: Max alert records
maxResults.description: alerts mode: cap on records written (and charged).
